description: List the IPv6 neighbor table (the IPv6 counterpart of ARP) on a MikroTik router: address, MAC, interface, reachability state, and whether the neighbor is a router. Supports filtering by interface and status, with pagination.

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

status.description: Only neighbors in this state, e.g. reachable, stale, delay, probe, failed, noarp

name: list_ipv6_neighbors
title: List IPv6 Neighbors
